WXFGrid.description:
Regular grid the samples are laid out on. Samples are row-major with
latitude as the outer index: cell (i, j) for 0 <= i < NLAT, 0 <= j < NLON
sits at VALUES[i * NLON + j] and is centred at
(LAT0 + i * DLAT, LON0 + j * DLON). DLAT is negative when rows run north
to south. Longitudes are in [-180, 180) or [0, 360) exactly as the
producer publishes them; a consumer normalises.

LAT0.description: Latitude of the first row's cell centre, degrees north.

LON0.description: Longitude of the first column's cell centre, degrees east.

PERIODIC_LON.description: Whether the last column wraps to the first (global grid).

WXF.description:
Weather Forecast Field - One variable, level, member and valid time on a
regular grid.

FIELD_ID.description:
Stable identifier of the whole field this record belongs to; equal
across all tiles of one (producer, init, member, variable, level, lead).

INIT_TIME_MS.description: Initialisation (analysis) time of the run, Unix milliseconds UTC.

VALID_TIME_MS.description:
Time the field is valid at, Unix milliseconds UTC
(INIT_TIME_MS + LEAD_HOURS * 3.6e6).

HORIZON_HOURS.description:
Maximum lead the run was integrated to, hours (e.g. 360 for a synoptic
cycle, 48 for an interim cycle).

MEMBER_KIND.description: Ensemble realisation or statistic the field represents.

MEMBER_INDEX.description: Zero-based member index when MEMBER_KIND is Member.

ENSEMBLE_SIZE.description: Number of members in the ensemble the run produced.

PERCENTILE.description: Percentile rank in [0, 100] when MEMBER_KIND is Percentile.

THRESHOLD_VALUE.description: Threshold in UNITS when MEMBER_KIND is a probability kind.

VARIABLE_NAME.description:
Producer's native variable name (always set; authoritative when
VARIABLE is Unspecified).

UNITS.description:
Units of every cell value, UCUM or CF style (e.g. "K", "m s-1", "Pa",
"1").

LEVEL_VALUE.description: Vertical coordinate value in the unit fixed by LEVEL_KIND.

TEMPORAL_KIND.description: Temporal character of each cell value.

ACCUMULATION_HOURS.description:
Accumulation or averaging window ending at VALID_TIME_MS, hours; 0 for
Instantaneous.

GRID.description: Grid geometry of this record's samples (of this tile when tiled).

TILE_INDEX.description: Zero-based tile index within FIELD_ID; 0 for an untiled field.

TILE_COUNT.description: Number of tiles FIELD_ID was split into; 1 for an untiled field.

CHUNK_CID.description:
Content identifier of the sample chunk when VALUES_ENCODING is
ContentAddressedChunk.

CHUNK_CODECS.description:
Codec chain applied to the chunk, outermost last (e.g. "bytes",
"zstd").

VALUE_MIN.description:
Minimum sample over the field (after decoding); statistics for display
scaling without touching the chunk.

VALUE_MAX.description: Maximum sample over the field (after decoding).

MISSING_COUNT.description: Number of cells with a missing value.

ORIGIN_ID.description:
Upstream publisher the field was retrieved from, as a host name or
stable identifier.

DATASET_ID.description:
Stable dataset identifier within the origin (e.g. a bucket, collection
or table name).

SOURCE_URL.description: Upstream URL or object path the field was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix milliseconds UTC when the field was retrieved from the origin.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence or terms the field is offered under.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publisher asks for.

PRODUCER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the node that ingested and published this record.
